tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search Hightouch documentation. Returns matching sections with title, heading, URL, content snippet, and section hierarchy. Use this to find relevant docs before reading full pages.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

section.description: Filter results to a specific section (e.g., 'Syncs', 'Customer Studio', 'Destinations')

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read the full markdown content of a Hightouch documentation page. Use the path from search results (e.g., '/syncs/overview'). Returns the complete page content in clean markdown.

path.description: The page path (e.g., '/syncs/overview', '/destinations/salesforce'). Use paths from search_docs results.
